prepare.operation: Only bounded local metadata endpoints /api/version, /api/tags, /api/show and /api/ps; no systemone/generate/pull request, no inference/download/unload.
prepare.model_adaptation: An explicitly selected already-installed local decision-capable model tag/digest/runtime is frozen before inference. A different model or runtime is a separate declared larger-host experiment, never the historical tev1:0.8b trial.
prepare.identity: Verify all111 original reference files, frozen fixture/rubric/protocols, every allowlisted native source, Node executable/version and current native xtask executable; preserve create-only private copies and declaration/checksum.
prepare.creation: Regular no-follow bounded inputs, new0700 declaration directory, new0600 evidence and0700 executable copies; no overwrite or silent repair.

run.order: Odd pairs Node then native, even pairs native then Node; each complete candidate unload precedes next engine.

child.owner: One blocking worker owns nonblocking pipes, unreaped leader identity, group termination and reap. Awaited close joins cleanup. Drop and cancelled join waiters cancel without blocking; the same bounded worker still owns cleanup.

run.metadata_and_sources: Before/after each engine reject reference, fixture, native source, Node/helper, tag/digest/runtime and declared-policy drift. Refuse any resident model before admission. Leave unrelated models unchanged; retain conflicts and cleanup failures.
run.conditions: Before/after observations include available OS/RAM/load/free/compressed/swap/pressure/power/residency. Normal-use conditions and no competing Ollama requests/builds/tests are operator declarations, separate from observed data. No host can be called controlled from those declarations.
run.cleanup: Ordinary evaluators unload their explicitly admitted candidate. After a terminated/interrupted child, inspect fresh bounded residency/digest/runtime and unload only the admitted exact candidate; never unload unknown/different/unrelated models. Verify no admitted model remains resident, otherwise mark incomplete/failure.
run.resume: Create-only declaration and run directories; interrupted and failed evidence is preserved. A new run directory may resume the same still-valid declaration; never append or overwrite an old run.

comparison.exact_scope: All cold/warm/stress case/round/expected/actual/classified/evaluator/source/model/error/status fields, state byte counts, and complete available provider input/output token metrics; missing fields remain distinct. Only wall_ms is excluded from categorical equality and every original timing remains in retained reports.
comparison.json_numeric_adaptation: The same finite JSON numeric value1 and1.0 is equivalent when comparing original serialized metadata/acceptance. No tolerance, threshold, relabeling or sample exclusion is introduced.
comparison.quality: Recompute each original strict warm and stress acceptance, retain inherited failures. All90 warm plus8 stress rows/engine/pair are required after a successful cold call. A failed cold call keeps its exact outcome/skip and cannot qualify a complete matrix.
comparison.failures: Keep every bidirectional finite-cutoff availability difference, schema/identity/transport/cancellation/cleanup failure and categorical mismatch. Matching labels or a zero-deadline run never qualifies a failed1500ms experiment.

separate_gates: No real calls are performed by deterministic tests or prepare.
No Claude/Jev inference, API keys, downloads, user configuration or routing permission changes.
Model label quality is independent of completed downstream Claude task quality.
Normal-use evidence is exploratory and cannot approve controlled representative hardware, shipping artifact provenance, platform/release/cutover or gateway performance gates.
